rows.10:3528:
Maybe Kuwahata had died back then because he'd been unconscious.
If he hadn't been made to breathe the chloroform, maybe he wouldn't have died...?
When he thought that, he couldn't stop himself from checking again.
Hah, there are still plenty of delinquents.
Push two or three more off and nobody'll be any worse off.
Aizawa thought such things with a smirk; by now there wasn't the slightest trace of guilt left in him.{p}
rows.10:4888:
'Dad, Mom, and everyone.
I am going to be eaten by the monster that lives on the roof.
If I do not become its sacrifice, there will be more and more victims.
I am setting off on a journey. Goodbye.'{p}
rows.10:4dc0:
Well then, let's go.
...I do think the story that a monster lives in this school is true.
I can't shake the feeling, myself, that someone is possessed by something.
No, I don't mean me.
I mean all of you at this school.
Though I suppose that includes me, too.{p}
